crons.comment: Annual loyalty points reset. Runs DAILY and does nothing on almost every one of those days — the handler checks appSettings/loyaltyReset and returns 'not-due' unless the configured date has passed. A daily no-op check is deliberate: an annual schedule would have exactly one chance a year to run, and a deploy, an outage or a timeout on that single day would silently skip the reset for twelve months. Daily means a missed run is retried tomorrow. Runs at 03:00 UTC, outside service hours in every branch.
